newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian March inflation slows to 12.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian March inflation slows to 12.3 pct.

text.p: Bulgaria's monthly consumer price inflation slowed to 12.3 percent in March from 242.7 percent in February due to the lev rise against the dollar, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said on Thursday.
BULGARIAN CONSUMER PRICES MARCH FEB MARCH'96
BREAKDOWN (cumulative inflation since Jan 1 in brackets)
"Inflation slowed down considerably last month because of the lev rise. It could have been around zero if energy and fuel prices have not risen sharply," a NSI official told Reuters.
The interim government raised energy and fuel prices last month as part of price liberalisation and in line with pledges to multilateral lenders to match prices with production costs.
Year-on-year figure for March inflation was expected later this month, the NSI said. February year-on-year inflation was 1,839 percent.
The lev rose to 1,570-1,800 per dollar in March from all-time lows of 2,500-3,200 the month before.
